name: Inclusive Cutpaper Deck
description: Create a client-ready executive presentation with layered cutpaper forms, editorial image windows, and exact, readable reporting. Built for course creators and designers presenting publishing work, audience insights, and decisions.
whatYouGet: A consistent cutpaper layout system across varied slide types
Readable charts, decisions, and evidence with preserved source wording
goodFit: Publishing performance reviews for client leadership
Course or content-program updates with clear next decisions
Editorial strategy presentations using approved photography
notFor: Dense financial statements that must reproduce every table
Decks that depend on unlicensed third-party photography
Reports requiring demographic claims unsupported by source data
requiredInputs: Audience and decision to be made
Target slide count and required sections
Approved visual assets or permission to use abstract paper shapes

faq.q: Will the deck preserve my figures and wording?
faq.a: Yes. Supplied metrics, quotes, units, and caveats should remain exact; missing evidence is flagged rather than invented.
Yes. The cutpaper system supports abstract silhouettes and color fields without implying that fictional images show real participants.
Yes. The deliverable is a self-contained HTML deck using system fonts and embedded styling.

demoPrompt: /sl-inclusive-cutpaper-deck Create exactly 9 slides for fictional independent publisher Fieldnote Publishing: review course reach and completion, identify reader drop-off, compare current and proposed formats, and decide on a six-week pilot. Title: “Our learning titles are reaching more readers.” Close: “We can approve the pilot and review the evidence in six weeks.” Use candid, accessible language and abstract cutpaper shapes.
followUpPrompts: Reframe the findings for a 10-minute leadership meeting without changing any figures.
Add source notes and caveats to each slide that contains a metric.
Make the decision slide more direct while preserving the approved wording.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
